scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm -w apps/api run dev" "npm -w apps/web run dev"
scripts.test:api: npm run db:up && npm -w apps/api run test:api
scripts.test:e2e: npm run db:up && npm -w apps/web run test:e2e
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
